priorityList: Use Racials, Trinkets, and Potions on cooldown.
Cast Black Ox Brew if you have zero Celestial Brew charges or are low on Energy.
If the Aspect of Harmony Spender buff is active, use Keg Smash if Empty Barrel is up, otherwise use Celestial Brew.
Cast Celestial Brew if you have high Aspect of Harmony accumulation (over 30% of max HP) or are about to cap charges.
Cast Blackout Kick on cooldown, ensuring you do not waste a Blackout Combo buff.
Use Purifying Brew and Fortifying Brew to manage incoming damage and stagger.
Cast Invoke Niuzao the Black Ox on cooldown.
Cast Exploding Keg if you have no charges of Keg Smash available.
Cast Empty the Cellar if Celestial Brew has more than 15 seconds remaining on cooldown.
Cast Breath of Fire if Niuzao is active, to trigger Flurry Strikes, or when Blackout Kick is on cooldown.
Use Keg Smash to prevent capping charges or to trigger Flurry Strikes and Scalding Brew.
Keep Rushing Jade Wind active at all times.
Use Tiger Palm to dump excess energy or to consume Blackout Combo when Blackout Kick is nearly ready to be reset.
Use Expel Harm as a last-resort filler.
